scope: All 54 distinct catalog papers; prior September 30 source audits retained, two additions reviewed 2026-10-28. Primary text and repository metadata/documentation only; no upstream code executed or results reproduced.

policy.default: References plus opt-in pinned git submodule or clone pointers; no upstream code vendored or automatically executed.
policy.no_license: Public visibility is not a redistribution license. Repository pointers are not a claim of permission to redistribute upstream code; no permission inferred from third-party license files or ancestry.
policy.permissive: MIT/Apache-2.0 root licenses are candidates for redistribution with preserved notices and full third-party review, not automatic clearance.
policy.copyleft: GPL artifact requires separate compliance review; clone/reference by default.
policy.execution: Commands are upstream documentation, not validated recommendations; never execute during collection.
policy.anonymous: No automatic clone without accessible stable source and explicit pin.
